scripts_used.extension_made: test_aetna_xmlfilter.py only printed the first 2000 raw characters of the top-level facet JSON/XML response and never drilled into the underlying data file. It was extended (in a new script, extract_aetna_activities.py, kept in the session scratchpad, not overwriting the original test file) to GET the actual XML data file directly at the DAM path already present as the literal `source` query parameter in test_aetna_xmlfilter.py, parse every <row> with lxml, split the combined "NNNN - Name" cpb field into cpb_number/cpb_name, parse date MM/DD/YYYY into ISO-8601, and sort all rows by real date descending. No new authentication, endpoint-guessing, or scraping mechanism was introduced.

xmlfilter_facet_service_confirmed_but_no.params_discovered_live: source, returnBy (repeatable), sortBy, filterBy (repeatable), filterValues (repeatable, plural -- NOT filterValue as guessed in an earlier ad hoc probe, which returned no drill-down), additionalValues (repeatable)

limitations_and_errors: The mcpb-changes.xml feed is a rolling recent-changes log (observed span ~4 months: 2026-04-20 to 2026-08-26); it is not a complete historical archive of every CPB change ever made, so 'latest 100' reflects the 100 most recent entries the feed currently exposes.

CPB numbering/date pairs can repeat in the source feed (a CPB can appear more than once if it was revised on two different dates within the feed window) -- these are kept as separate distinct activity records since each is a distinct dated event, matching the task definition of 'activity'.
2 of the 358 feed rows are status=04-Deleted with an empty url field (no live page exists post-deletion) -- this is expected/correct, not a scraping failure.

test_aetna_network_capture.py: the precertification-lists page target caused a real Chromium crash (Page.goto: Page crashed) in this sandboxed VM when run headless -- this is a local browser-automation/environment limitation, not a site-side auth wall or CAPTCHA. No login, token, or CAPTCHA was ever encountered on any Aetna URL in this task; all data was retrieved from fully public, unauthenticated endpoints.

The xmlfilter AEM service itself (returnBy=status/listing/month) only returns shallow facet-option lists, not row-level data, unless drilled through its filterBy/filterValues/returnBy chain one level at a time (confirmed via Playwright); the direct DAM XML fetch was used instead as the equivalent, more complete, single-request source of the same underlying data.

No fabrication: every date, CPB number/name, status, and URL in aetna_cpb_changes_top100.json and aetna_cpb_periodic_reviews_top100.json was copied verbatim (after MM/DD/YYYY-to-ISO parsing and 'NNNN - Name' string splitting only) from the live HTTP response bytes captured at retrieval_timestamp_utc above.
